blocks.text: Sahara (support) aur harkat (movement) insani hayatiyat ke bunyadi pehlu hain, jo hamein sada chalne-phirne se pecheeda kaamon tak sargarmiyon ki ek wasee range ke qabil banate hain. Haddiyan (bones), cartilage aur doosre connective tissues ek andarooni dhancha (framework), dhancha-e-haddi (skeleton), banate hain jo banawati sahara deta, aham aza ki hifazat karta, aur harkat aur naqal-o-harkat (locomotion) paida karta hai.
Haddi ki banawat

Haddiyan calcium aur khaas haddi ke cells se mazboot kiye gaye connective tissue ki bani hain. Haddi ki satah ek sakht jhilli, periosteum, se dhaki hai. Periosteum ke neeche moti tah sakht madde ki hai, compact bone, jo haddi ke tissue ka zyada tar hissa banati hai. Haddi ke chaure sire epiphyses hain, aur us ki lambai ke saath darmiyani hissa diaphysis ya shaft.

Compact bone ki bunyadi banawati ikaiyan Haversian systems hain. Haversian system lamellae ka bana hai, maadni (mineralised) extracellular matrix ki ham-markaz (concentric) tahein jin mein collagen reshe aur calcium phosphate ke chhote sui-numa qalm (crystals) hain; qalm bhurbhure magar sakht hain, jo haddi ko bari mazbooti dete hain, jab ke collagen lachakdar magar kamzor hai, to haddi mazboot aur lachakdar dono hai. Lamellae chhoti jagahon, lacunae, se alag hain, jin mein osteocytes, pakke haddi ke cells, hote hain; osteocytes ek doosre se aur Haversian canal se chhoti naliyon, canaliculi, se jure hain. Ham-markaz lamellae ek markazi Haversian canal ko gherte hain, jis mein khoon ki naliyan, asaab aur lymphatic naliyan hain. Haversian canals ke amood (perpendicular) chalne wali chhoti naliyan unhen ek doosre aur periosteum se jorti hain aur khoon ki naliyan, asaab aur lymphatic naliyan bhi le jati hain, aur collagen reshe periosteum ko neeche ki haddi se jorte hain, jo izafi mazbooti aur istehkam deta hai. Compact bone ke neeche spongy bone hai, haddi ki keelon (spikes) ka jaal jo use halka aur mazboot banata hai.

blocks.alt: Teen jure hue khaake. Baen: ek lambi haddi jis par epiphysis, diaphysis aur epiphysis ke brackets hain; siron mein spongy bone hai, shaft ki deewar compact bone ki hai jo bone marrow ko gherti hai, aur satah par periosteum hai. Darmiyan: shaft ki deewar ka bara kiya hua tukra, ek taraf spongy bone aur doosri taraf Haversian systems se bani compact bone; har system Haversian canal ke gird lamellae ke halqon (rings) ka hai.

blocks.long_description: Teen jure hue khaake. Baen: ek lambi haddi jis par epiphysis, diaphysis aur epiphysis ke brackets hain; siron mein spongy bone hai, shaft ki deewar compact bone ki hai jo bone marrow ko gherti hai, aur satah par periosteum hai. Darmiyan: shaft ki deewar ka bara kiya hua tukra, ek taraf spongy bone aur doosri taraf Haversian systems se bani compact bone; har system Haversian canal ke gird lamellae ke halqon (rings) ka hai. Daen: ek Haversian system ka chautha hissa jis mein lacunae ke andar osteocytes hain jo canaliculi se jure hain, extracellular matrix ke beech.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baen se daen parhein: poori haddi, phir us ki deewar ka tukra, phir ek Haversian system. Lambi haddi ke siron (epiphysis) mein jaali jaisi spongy bone hai aur beech ke shaft (diaphysis) ki deewar thos compact bone ki. Compact bone Haversian systems ki bani hai: beech mein canal (khoon ki naliyan aur asaab) aur us ke gird lamellae ke halqe. Halqon ke darmiyan lacunae mein osteocytes rehte hain, aur barik canaliculi unhein aapas mein aur canal se jorti hain taake ghiza pohanch sake.
Haddi ka gooda (bone marrow)

Bohat si haddiyon mein ek narm tissue, bone marrow (gooda), bhi hota hai, jo surkh ya zard ho sakta hai. Surkh gooda spongy bone, lambi haddiyon ke siron, pasliyon, vertebrae, sternum aur pelvis mein hota hai, aur red blood cells, platelets aur white blood cells banata hai. Zard gooda lambi haddiyon ke shafts ko bharta hai; yeh zyada tar charbi ke cells par mushtamil hai aur tawanai ke zakheere ka kaam karta hai, aur shadeed khoon ke ziyan par surkh goode mein badal kar khoon ke cells bana sakta hai.

blocks.title: Zinda haddi
blocks.text: Apni tadaad aur jasamat ke bawajood haddiyan jism ki kamiyat ka 20% se kam hain. Haddiyan khushk, sakht banawatein nahin jaisi woh nazar aati hain; yeh nam, zinda tissues hain.
Haddi ke cells ki qismein

Teen qism ke cells, osteoblasts, osteocytes aur osteoclasts, haddiyon ki nashonuma, barhotri aur dobara banawat (remodelling) mein shamil hain. Osteoblasts haddi banane wale cells hain jo ghair-maadni ground substance banate aur chhorte hain; matrix se ghir jane par yeh osteocytes ban jate hain. Osteocytes pakke haddi ke cells hain jo enzymes aur haddi ka maadni mawad chhor kar sehatmand haddi ka tissue qaim rakhte hain, aur haddi se khoon mein calcium ke ikhraj ko qaboo karte hain. Osteoclasts macrophages se bante hain aur haddi ki resorption karte hain: yeh haddi torte aur calcium aur phosphate khoon mein chhorte hain, jo haddi ki barhotri aur marammat ke liye aham kaam hai.

blocks.alt: Teeron se jure haddi ke cells ki qatar: tissue ki tah ke neeche osteogenic cell (stem cell), phir bone matrix ke neeche osteoblasts ki qatar (bone matrix banate hain), phir shakhon wala osteocyte (pukhta haddi ka cell); saath haddi ki satah par kai nuclei wala bara osteoclast (haddi ko ghulata hai).
blocks.caption: Figure 12.2: Haddi ke cells ki qismein (kitab ki Figure 12.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teer nashonuma ka rasta dikhate hain: osteogenic stem cell se osteoblasts bante hain, jo matrix bana kar khud us mein qaid ho jate hain aur osteocytes ban jate hain. Osteoclast is raste ka hissa nahin; yeh kai nuclei wala bara cell hai jo purani haddi ko tor kar (resorb) remodelling mein madad deta hai.
Haddi ki nashonuma

Haddi banne ka amal osteogenesis hai. Yeh embryonic nashonuma mein shuru hota aur zindagi bhar jari rehta hai, haddiyon ki barhotri, dekh-bhaal aur marammat mein aham kirdar ada karta hai. Is ke do bunyadi raste hain.

items: Femur aur humerus jaisi lambi haddiyan cartilage ke haddi mein badalne se banti hain. Cartilage ka markaz sakht (calcify) hone lagta hai, wahan ke chondrocytes (cartilage ke cells) mar kar khale chhor jate hain, aur khoon ki naliyan in khalon mein dakhil ho kar osteoblasts aur osteoclasts lati hain. Osteoblasts haddi ka tissue banana shuru karte hain, cartilage ki jagah nai haddi laate hain; woh qadam jis mein maadniyat jama ho kar cartilage ki jagah haddi leti hai ossification hai. Osteoclasts calcified cartilage torte hain, taake mazeed haddi banne ki jagah bane. Jaise haddi pakti hai kuch osteoblasts haddi ke tissue mein phans kar osteocytes ban jate hain, jo haddi ki banawat qaim rakhte hain. Yeh amal tab tak jari rehta hai jab tak tamam cartilage haddi na ban jaye, siwaye us cartilage ke jo joron (articular) ki sathon par rehti hai.

Chand haddiyan, maslan khopri (skull) ki kuch haddiyan, pehle cartilage banaye baghair seedhi sakht haddi mein banti hain. In ke osteocytes pehle embryonic connective tissue mein be-tarteeb bikhre hote hain magar jald tahon mein mil kar haddi ki chapti plates ban jate hain.

blocks.alt: Lambi haddi ke paanch marhale, teeron se jure aur barhte hue: cartilage ka model; shaft ke beech ossification ki pehli jagah; shaft mein phailti haddi aur marrow cavity mein khoon ki naliyan; ek sire mein ossification ki doosri jagah; aur poori haddi jis ke siron par sirf articular cartilage bachti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.3: Cartilage se haddi ki nashonuma (kitab ki Figure 12.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neela rang cartilage hai aur peela haddi. Pehle poora dhancha cartilage ka hota hai; phir shaft ke beech haddi banna shuru hoti hai (first site). Khoon ki naliyan andar aati hain aur gooda (marrow) ki jagah banti hai. Baad mein siron mein doosri jagah (second site) se haddi banti hai. Aakhir mein sirf joron ki satah par articular cartilage reh jati hai.

blocks.title: Remodelling
blocks.text: Haddiyon ke poori tarah ban jane ke baad bhi osteogenesis bone remodelling ki shakal mein jari rehti hai, yani osteoclasts se purani haddi ka toota aur osteoblasts se nai haddi ka banna.
Cartilage ki banawat

Janeen (foetus) ki zyada tar cartilage haddi se badal jati hai, magar kuch zindagi bhar rehti aur lachak deti hai, maslan haddiyon ke darmiyan, naak ke sire par, bairooni kaan mein aur trachea ke andar ke saath. Connective tissue ki ek tah, perichondrium, cartilage ko gherti hai aur us mein use khoon dene wali khoon ki naliyan, lymphatic naliyan aur asaab hain. Perichondrium ke andar cartilage matrix hai, jo collagen, elastin, proteoglycans aur doosre reshon par mushtamil hai aur tissue ko mazbooti, lachak aur dabao ki muzahimat deti hai. Doosre connective tissues ke bar-aks cartilage matrix ke andar khoon ki naliyan nahin hotin; cells ko diffusion se ghiza milti hai, aur isi wajah se cartilage bohat aahista theek hoti hai. Cartilage ke cells, chondrocytes, matrix mein dhansi chhoti jagahon, lacunae, mein hote hain, aur matrix banane aur qaim rakhne ke zimmedar hain.
Cartilage ki qismein

Cartilage teen qism ki hai. Hyaline cartilage sab se aam hai aur naak, trachea aur joron mein haddiyon ki articulating sathon par milti hai. Fibrocartilage wahan milti hai jahan jism zyada dabao aur tanao sehta hai, jaise intervertebral discs aur pubic symphysis. Elastic cartilage bairooni kaan aur epiglottis mein milti hai.

blocks.alt: Cartilage ke teen blocks, har ek ke upar gulabi perichondrium ki tah: hyaline cartilage jis mein lacunae ke andar chondrocytes kam reshon wali sada matrix mein phaile hain; fibrocartilage jis mein ghane mutawazi collagen reshon ke beech kam chondrocytes hain; elastic cartilage jis mein bikhre chhote reshon ke beech bohat se chondrocytes hain. blocks.caption: Figure 12.4: Cartilage ki qismein (kitab ki Figure 12.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teenon mein woh hi cheezein hain: upar perichondrium, andar matrix, aur lacunae mein chondrocytes. Farq reshon mein hai: hyaline mein reshe kam aur matrix sheeshe jaisi, fibrocartilage mein ghane collagen reshe (mazbooti, jaise discs mein), elastic mein elastic reshe (lachak, jaise kaan ki lau mein).

blocks.text: Dhancha-e-haddi mein haddiyon ki tarteeb
Insani skeletal nizam 206 haddiyon par mushtamil hai, do bari taqseemon mein: axial skeleton aur appendicular skeleton.

blocks.alt: Jism ke khaake ke andar poore skeleton ka saamne ka manzar; axial haddiyan neeli aur appendicular gulabi. Daen axial labels: Cranium aur Facial bones (Skull), Middle ear Ossicles, Neck bone (Hyoid), Chest bone (Sternum), Ribs, Vertebral column. Baen appendicular labels: Pectoral girdle, Humerus, Ulna, Radius, Pelvic girdle, Carpals, Metacarpals, Phalanges, Femur, Patella, Tibia, Fibula, Tarsals, Metatarsals, Phalanges.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.5: Insani skeleton (kitab ki Figure 12.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neeli haddiyan jism ka mehwar (axis) hain: khopri, reerh ki haddi, pasliyan aur seene ki haddi; yeh dimagh, dil aur phephron ki hifazat karti hain. Gulabi haddiyan bazu, taangein aur un ko jorne wale girdles hain; yeh harkat ke liye hain.
Axial skeleton

Axial skeleton jism ka mehwar (axis) banata hai; is ki haddiyan sar, gardan aur seene ke aza ko sahara aur hifazat deti hain. Yeh khopri (skull), pasliyon (ribs), reerh (spine) aur sternum par mushtamil hai.

items: Khopri: 22 haddiyan. Aath cranial haddiyan cranium (dimagh ka dabba) banati hain: do jori haddiyan parietal aur temporal hain, aur chaar akeli haddiyan frontal, occipital, ethmoid aur sphenoid. Chaudah chehre (facial) ki haddiyan cranium se juri hain: chhe jori haddiyan lacrimal, zygomatic, nasal, inferior nasal concha, maxilla aur palatine hain, aur do akeli haddiyan mandible (jabre ki haddi) aur vomer.
Darmiyani kaan: chhe haddiyan (teen jore), ossicles: malleus, incus aur stapes.
Gardan ki haddi: hyoid ek chhoti akeli haddi hai jo khopri ki bunyad par zaban ke neeche hai; yeh sar ki kisi doosri haddi se nahin jurti.

Reerh ki haddi (vertebral column): paanch girohon mein 33 vertebrae. Gardan mein saat cervical vertebrae, pehla atlas aur doosra axis; seene mein barah thoracic vertebrae, jo pasliyan uthate hain; pait ke ilaqe mein paanch lumbar vertebrae; paanch sacral vertebrae jo mil kar sacrum banate hain, jo koolhe ki iliac haddiyon se jur kar pelvis ka pichla hissa banata hai; aur chaar coccygeal vertebrae ya coccyx, baligon mein jure hue. Sacral aur coccygeal vertebrae mil kar pelvic vertebrae hain.

Pasliyon ka pinjra aur seene ki haddi: 24 pasliyan (12 jore) aur ek sternum, seene ke markaz mein lambi chapti haddi. Pasliyan peeche thoracic vertebrae se jurti hain; samne saat jore alag alag costal cartilages se seedhe sternum se jurte hain (true ribs), 8th, 9th aur 10th jore ek mushtarak costal cartilage se jurte hain (false ribs), aur aakhri do jore (11th aur 12th) floating ribs hain jo sternum se nahin jurte.

blocks.alt: Khopri ke do manzar, har haddi apne rang mein. Pehlu ka manzar: Frontal, Parietal (2), Temporal (2), Occipital, Sphenoid, Ethmoid, Nasal (2), Lacrimal (2), Zygomatic (2), Maxilla (2) aur Mandible, jabra temporal haddi par jura hua. Saamne ka manzar chehre ki haddiyon ke liye: Nasal (2), Lacrimal (2), Inferior nasal concha (2), Maxilla (2), Mandible, Palatine (2), Zygomatic (2) aur Vomer.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.6: Insani khopri (kitab ki Figure 12.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (2) ka matlab hai ke yeh haddi jore mein hai, ek daen aur ek baen. Pehlu ke manzar mein cranium ki aath haddiyan (frontal, do parietal, do temporal, occipital, sphenoid, ethmoid) dimagh ko gherti hain. Saamne ka manzar chehre ki 14 haddiyan dikhata hai; palatine munh ki chhat ke peechhe hai, is liye nuqtedar lakeer se dikhai gayi hai. Neeche ka jabra (mandible) khopri ki akeli harkat karne wali haddi hai.

blocks.alt: Kaan ki kaat jis par external ear, middle ear aur internal ear ke brackets hain. Kaan ki nali eardrum par khatam hoti hai; malleus eardrum ko chhoota hai, incus darmiyan mein hai, aur stapes ka paon internal ear ki oval window mein betha hai. Teer teenon haddiyon ke bare manzar tak jata hai: Malleus, Incus, Stapes.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.7: Darmiyani kaan ki haddiyan (ossicles) (kitab ki Figure 12.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen chhoti haddiyan ek zanjeer hain: eardrum ki thartharahat malleus se incus aur phir stapes tak jati hai, aur stapes use oval window ke zariye andaruni kaan tak pohanchata hai. Har kaan mein yeh teen haddiyan hain, is liye dono kaanon mein chhe.

blocks.alt: S ki shakal mein mura hua vertebral column pehlu se, har hissa apne rang mein aur bracket ke saath: Cervical (7), Thoracic (12), Lumbar (5), Sacral (5 jure hue) aur Coccygeal (4 jure hue). Pehle do vertebrae Atlas aur Axis likhe hain; vertebrae ke darmiyan intervertebral disc hai, aur un ke peechhe spinal cord chalti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.8: Reerh ki haddi (vertebral column) (kitab ki Figure 12.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Gin kar dekhein: 7 cervical, 12 thoracic, 5 lumbar; sacral aur coccygeal vertebrae aapas mein jur kar ek ek haddi bana lete hain. Neeche ke vertebrae bare hain kyunke un par zyada wazan hai. Discs jhatke jazb karti hain, aur S jaisa khum do-paya chalne mein tawazun deta hai.

blocks.alt: Pasliyon ka pinjra saamne se: thoracic vertebrae se nikalti 1 se 12 tak gini hui baarah jore pasliyan, beech mein sternum aur pasliyon ko us se jorne wali costal cartilage. 1 se 7 true ribs hain jo apni cartilage se sternum se juri hain; 8 se 10 false ribs hain jo pasli 7 ki cartilage ke zariye juri hain; 11 aur 12 floating ribs hain jin ke agle sire azad hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.9: Pasliyon ka pinjra (rib cage) (kitab ki Figure 12.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Rang se qismein pehchanein: narangi true ribs (seedha sternum se), zaitooni false ribs (sternum tak baalwasta), aur surmai floating ribs (aage se kisi se nahin juri). Safed hisse costal cartilage hain jo pinjre ko saans ke waqt lachak dete hain.
Appendicular skeleton
Appendicular skeleton mein aza-e-jism (appendages), yani bazuon aur taangon, ki haddiyan shamil hain: pectoral girdle, pelvic girdle, forelimbs aur hindlimbs.

items: Pectoral girdle: haddiyon ke do jore, clavicles (hansli, collar bones) ka ek jora aur scapulae (kandhe ki haddiyan) ka ek jora. Har clavicle ka ek sira sternum se aur doosra scapula se jurta hai.

Forelimbs: har bazu, kalai, haath aur ungliyon mein 30 haddiyan. Ek humerus, lambi haddi jis ka gol sar glenoid cavity mein bethta hai; ek ulna aur ek radius, lambi haddiyan, ulna bazu ke andar ki taraf aur radius bahar (angoothe) ki taraf, ulna zara bari; aath carpals, do qataron mein chhoti haddiyan jo kalai banati hain, oopri qatar radius se kalai ke jor par jurti hai; paanch metacarpals jo hatheli banate hain; aur chaudah phalanges, har ungli mein teen aur angoothe mein do.

Pelvic girdle: koolhe ki do haddiyan, har ek teen haddiyon, ilium, ischium aur pubis, ki, jin ka milap ek haddi ka socket, acetabulum, banata hai. Dono koolhe ki haddiyan samne pubic symphysis se juri hain, jism ki darmiyani lakeer par ek cartilaginous jor.

Hindlimbs: har taang, takhne, pair aur ungliyon mein 30 haddiyan. Ek femur, raan ki lambi haddi jis ka sar acetabulum mein bethta hai; ek patella ya ghutne ki chapni, jo ghutne ke jor par chalne wale lambe tendon mein dhansi hai; ek tibia ya pindli ki haddi, taang ki bari haddi, aur ek fibula, patli bairooni haddi jo ghutne ke theek neeche aur takhne ke theek oopar tibia se jurti hai; saat tarsals, chhoti haddiyan kas kar juri hui jo takhna banati hain; paanch metatarsals, jo tarsals aur phalanges se jur kar talwa banate hain; aur chaudah phalanges, har ungli mein teen aur bare angoothe mein do.

blocks.text: Jor (joints)

Jor (joint) woh jagah hai jahan do haddiyan, ya haddi aur cartilage, milti hain. Insani jism mein teen bari qismein hain: fibrous (na hilne wale) jor, cartilaginous (zara hilne wale) jor aur synovial (azadi se hilne wale) jor.

items: Fibrous jor: haddiyan zyada tar collagen ke fibrous connective tissue se seedhi juri hain, aur koi harkat mumkin nahin. Misalein khopri ki na hilne wali haddiyon ke darmiyan sutures, nichli taang mein tibia aur fibula ke darmiyan jor, aur jabre ki haddi mein daanton aur un ke sockets ke darmiyan jor hain.

Cartilaginous jor: haddiyan cartilage ki tah se juri hain aur thori harkat mumkin hai. Kuch mein haddiyan hyaline cartilage se juri hain, maslan pehli pasli aur sternum ka jor; doosron mein fibrocartilage se, maslan pelvic girdle ki pubic symphysis aur intervertebral discs.

Synovial jor: sab se aam qism, jo harkat ki wasee range deti hai. Ek hamwar, sakht, lachakdar hyaline cartilage, articular cartilage, haddiyon ke siron ko dhanpti aur hamwar, ragar ke baghair satah deti hai. Ek fibrous capsule jor ko gherta aur haddiyon ko jore rakhne mein madad karta hai; is mein ligaments ki bairooni tah aur synovial membrane ki andarooni tah hai, jo synovial fluid banati hai jo jor ko chikna rakhta hai. Haddiyon ko jorne wali connective tissue ki mazboot pattiyan ligaments hain.

blocks.text: Harkat ki range ke lihaz se synovial jor ki chhe bari qismein hain. Ball-and-socket jor har simt harkat dete hain, jaise kandhe aur koolhe par. Hinge jor sirf ek satah mein harkat dete hain, darwaze ke qabze ki tarah, jaise kohni aur ghutne par. Pivot jor ek mehwar ke gird ghoomne dete hain, jaise gardan ke pehle aur doosre vertebrae ke darmiyan. Ellipsoidal jor do sathon mein harkat dete hain magar ghoomna nahin, jaise kalai ka radius ke saath jor. Saddle jor do sathon mein harkat dete hain kyunke ek haddi ki satah mehrabi (concave) aur doosri ki ubhri (convex) hai, jaise angoothe par. Gliding jor haddiyon ke darmiyan phisalne ki harkat dete hain, jaise vertebrae ke darmiyan aur kalai aur takhne ki haddiyon ke darmiyan.

blocks.alt: (a) Ek skeleton jis par har jor ke chhote khaake se us ki jagah tak teer hain: fibrous jor (khopri ki silai), synovial pivot jor (gardan), cartilaginous jor (vertebrae ke darmiyan), synovial ball and socket jor (kandha aur koolha), saddle jor (angootha), ellipsoid jor (kalai), gliding jor (paon ki haddiyan) aur hinge jor (ghutna).

blocks.long_description: (a) Ek skeleton jis par har jor ke chhote khaake se us ki jagah tak teer hain: fibrous jor (khopri ki silai), synovial pivot jor (gardan), cartilaginous jor (vertebrae ke darmiyan), synovial ball and socket jor (kandha aur koolha), saddle jor (angootha), ellipsoid jor (kalai), gliding jor (paon ki haddiyan) aur hinge jor (ghutna). (b) Synovial jor: bone 1 aur bone 2 jin ke siron par articular cartilage hai, darmiyan synovial fluid, us ko gherti synovial membrane, bahar fibrous capsule aur us se bahar ligament.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (a) mein gulabi teer har jor ki harkat dikhate hain: ball and socket har simt, hinge sirf ek simt (darwaze ki tarah), pivot ghoomna, saddle do simt, ellipsoid do simt, gliding sirf sarakna. Fibrous aur cartilaginous jor bilkul ya taqreeban nahin hilte. (b) mein synovial jor ki tahein andar se bahar: cartilage, fluid, membrane, capsule, ligament.

blocks.title: Joint transplantation
blocks.text: Joint transplantation ek surgery hai jis mein kharab jor ko donor ke sehatmand qudrati jor ya masnooi jor se badla jata hai. Total joint replacement mein poora kharab jor dhaat, plastic ya ceramic ke masnooi jor se badla jata hai; partial joint replacement mein sirf kharab hissa masnooi juz se badla jata hai, aksar ghutne mein; allograft transplantation mein donor ka sehatmand jor kharab jor ki jagah lagaya jata hai, aksar takhne aur ghutne mein; aur chondrocyte implantation mein mareez ke apne jor ke chondrocytes kharab jor mein lagaye jate hain, aksar ghutne mein.
Skeleton, pathe aur do-paya (bipedal) posture

Insanon ki do-paya (bipedal) posture skeleton aur pathon se kai tarah juri hai. Insani reerh ki haddi mein ek numayan S ki shakal ka khum hai, jo wazan barabar taqseem karta aur khare hone aur chalne mein tawazun qaim rakhta hai. Pelvis chhoti aur chauri hai, jo dhar ko mustahkam karti aur do taangon par jism ka wazan sambhalti hai. Femur ghutne ki taraf andar ko mura hai, jo jism ke markaz-e-saql ko pairon ke oopar rakhta hai aur khare hone aur chalne mein istehkam deta hai. Koolhon (buttocks) ke pathe insanon mein kahin bare hain aur dhar ko mustahkam karte aur chalte waqt jism ko aage dhakelte hain, aur pindli ke pathe achhi tarah bane hain, jo chalne aur daurne ki taqat dete hain. Pair mein ek tooli mehrab (longitudinal arch) hai jo jhatka jazb karti aur wazan barabar taqseem karti hai, aur ungliyan chhoti aur kam pakarne wali hain, to pair chalne aur daurne mein lever ke taur par behtar kaam karta hai.

blocks.title: Ghalat posture ke masail
blocks.text: Ghalat posture haddiyon aur joron ko nuqsan pohncha sakti hai. Vertebrae ki be-tarteebi vertebrae aur asaab par dabao daal kar kamar aur gardan ke dard aur herniated discs tak le ja sakti hai. Gardan, kandhon, koolhon aur ghutnon ke joron par tanao dard, soozish aur mumkina taur par arthritis tak le jata hai. Ghalat posture se zyada aur kam istemal hone wale pathon ka adam-tawazun haddiyon aur joron ko tarteeb se bahar kheench sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Tooti hui femur chand mahinon mein jur jati hai, magar ghutne mein articular cartilage ka phata tukra shayad kabhi poori tarah theek na ho. Dono tissues ki banawat se farq samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Haddi ke Haversian canals aur periosteum mein khoon ki naliyan hain, aur zinda osteoblasts, osteocytes aur osteoclasts hain jo zindagi bhar use remodel karte hain, to yeh barh aur khud marammat kar sakti hai. Cartilage matrix mein khoon ki naliyan nahin; us ke lacunae mein chondrocytes ko sirf matrix se diffusion se ghiza milti hai, to is ki khud marammat ki salahiyat mehdood hai aur yeh bohat aahista theek hoti hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Haddi: compact bone par periosteum (lamellae ke Haversian systems, osteocytes wali lacunae, canaliculi, markazi canal) spongy bone par; surkh gooda khoon ke cells banata, zard gooda charbi rakhta hai; epiphyses aur diaphysis.

Osteoblasts banate, osteocytes qaim rakhte, osteoclasts resorb karte hain. Lambi haddiyan cartilage ke model se ossify hoti hain; khopri ki kuch haddiyan seedhi banti hain; remodelling zindagi bhar jari rehti hai.

Cartilage: perichondrium, khoon ki naliyon ke baghair collagen, elastin aur proteoglycans ki matrix, lacunae mein chondrocytes; hyaline (naak, trachea, jor), fibrocartilage (discs, pubic symphysis), elastic (kaan, epiglottis); aahista theek hoti hai.

206 haddiyan: axial (khopri 22, ossicles 6, hyoid, paanch girohon mein 33 vertebrae, 24 pasliyan aur sternum) aur appendicular (pectoral girdle, 30 haddiyon ke forelimbs, pelvic girdle, 30 haddiyon ke hindlimbs).

Jor: fibrous (na hilne wale), cartilaginous (zara hilne wale), synovial (azad; articular cartilage, capsule, ligaments, synovial fluid; chhe qismein). Do-paya posture S ki shakal ki reerh, chauri pelvis, mure femur, koolhe aur pindli ke pathon, mehrabi pair aur chhoti ungliyon par qaim hai.
